title: AOC-4 and MGT-7 for FY 2025-26: MCA Extends Fee-Free Filing Deadlines
excerpt: MCA has waived additional fees for AOC-4 filed by 31 December 2026 and MGT-7/MGT-7A by 31 January 2027. Learn who it covers, what it does not and how to file in time.
body:
If your company's AOC-4 or MGT-7 for FY 2025-26 is still pending, there is good news. The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has given companies extra time to file these annual forms without paying additional fees. But the relief has a hard end date, and missing it brings back the full late fee counted from your original due date.

Here is what changed, who it covers and what you should do now.

## What the MCA has announced

Through **General Circular No. 05/2026 dated 24 October 2026**, the MCA has relaxed additional fees for annual filings for the financial year 2025-26. The new fee-free windows are:

- **31 December 2026** for financial statement forms: AOC-4, AOC-4 (CFS), AOC-4 XBRL, AOC-4 NBFC (Ind AS) and AOC-4 CFS NBFC (Ind AS).
- **31 January 2027** for annual returns: MGT-7 and MGT-7A.

Within these dates, you pay only the normal filing fee. No additional fee is charged even if your original due date has already passed.

## Why this matters

Normally, a company holds its Annual General Meeting (AGM) within six months of the year end. For a 31 March 2026 year end, that means by **30 September 2026**. After the AGM:

- **AOC-4** (financial statements) is due within **30 days** of the AGM.
- **MGT-7 / MGT-7A** (annual return) is due within **60 days** of the AGM.

So a company that held its AGM on 30 September 2026 had to file AOC-4 by 30 October 2026 and MGT-7 by 29 November 2026. Late filing normally attracts an additional fee of **Rs 100 per day per form**, with no upper limit. A few months of delay on two forms can add up to a large amount, before any penalties on the company and its officers.

The circular pushes the fee-free deadline well beyond these dates, so many companies that are running late can still file at normal cost.

## Who should use this relief

- Private limited companies and public companies that have not yet filed AOC-4 or MGT-7 for FY 2025-26.
- One Person Companies (OPCs) and small companies filing **MGT-7A**.
- Companies whose accounts are audited but whose forms are held up by pending signatures, DSC issues or missing details.
- Companies with subsidiaries that need to file consolidated statements in AOC-4 (CFS).

If you have already filed, nothing changes for you.

## What the relief does not cover

Read the fine print before you relax:

- **It does not extend the AGM date.** The circular clearly says it is not an extension of time for holding AGMs. If your company did not hold its AGM on time, it can still face action for that default.
- **Other forms keep their own deadlines.** For example, ADT-1 (auditor appointment) and DIR-12 (director changes) are not covered.
- **Miss the new date and the old clock returns.** A form filed after 31 December 2026 (AOC-4) or 31 January 2027 (MGT-7) pays the full additional fee, calculated from the **original** due date, not from the extended date.
- **Your accounts must still be ready.** The financial statements must be audited and approved by the board and adopted at the AGM before AOC-4 can be filed.

Cost audit reports in Form CRA-4 for FY 2025-26 have a separate relaxation up to 31 December 2026 under General Circular No. 06/2026, so check that too if cost audit applies to you.

## A simple checklist for the next few weeks

- **Confirm your AGM date** and keep the notice, minutes and attendance records ready.
- **Check your DSCs.** Make sure the director's and professional's digital signatures are valid and registered on the MCA V3 portal.
- **Collect attachments** for AOC-4: signed financial statements, auditor's report, board's report and, where needed, CSR details.
- **Prepare MGT-7 data**: shareholding pattern, list of shareholders, details of directors and KMP, meetings held and share transfers during the year.
- **Check the director KYC status** of all directors. A deactivated DIN can stop the form from being signed.
- **File early, not on 31 December.** The MCA portal often slows down near deadlines. Aim to finish AOC-4 by mid-December and MGT-7 by mid-January.

## What if you also missed earlier years?

This circular is only for FY 2025-26. If filings for earlier years are pending, the normal additional fees apply to those years unless a separate scheme is notified. It is worth reviewing your full MCA filing history now, since a company with continuing defaults risks being marked as non-compliant, and its directors may face disqualification.
